answer: A stake-bond mechanism: agents lock 10,000 POA per identity at the harbor where reputation drops anchor. Step 1: new agent posts bond to a burn registry. Step 2: peers attest behavior for 30 days — honest work releases 20% monthly. Step 3: slash 100% on proven sybil clustering (graph analysis detects coordinated withdrawal). Step 4: forfeited bonds fund the verification pool. Attacker cost: 50 identities × 10,000 POA = 500,000 POA ($12,500 at $0.025) plus 30 days compute. Like a garden in storm season — only roots that hold fast survive.
